purpose: Reference scaffolding for Windows/IAM UCs using Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows (Splunkbase 742) and WinEventLog:Security. Authors adapt — do not paste verbatim.

ta.name: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows
ta.scope: Universal Forwarder on Domain Controllers and member servers; WinEventLog://Security, System, Application

kfps.scenario: Password spray against many accounts from one Source_Network_Address with low per-account counts.
kfps.distinguish: Each Account_Name has <5 failures but distinct accounts >50; use separate UC or widen stats window.
kfps.suppress: Track in threat-hunting dashboard; do not lower brute-force threshold globally.

kfps.scenario: Service account lockout after password rotation — legitimate Kerberos failure burst.
kfps.distinguish: Account_Name ends in `$` or appears in `privileged_accounts` lookup with `rotation_window` flag.
kfps.suppress: Time-bound entry in `iam_exception_register.csv` keyed on Account_Name during rotation change ticket.

kfps.scenario: Break-glass administrator testing after quarterly credential roll.
kfps.distinguish: Active CHG in ServiceNow with `break_glass=true` and matching admin Account_Name.
kfps.suppress: Filter via `lookup break_glass_accounts Account_Name OUTPUT valid_until | where now() < valid_until`.

kfps.scenario: Vulnerability scanner or red-team cred stuffing from approved scanner netblock.
kfps.distinguish: Source_Network_Address in `approved_scanners.csv`; User-Agent or Logon_Process in 4625 matches scanner signature.
kfps.suppress: Exclude CIDR via `where NOT cidrmatch("10.50.0.0/16", Source_Network_Address)` or scanner lookup join.

troubleshooting.cause: Audit policy missing Failure logons or UF not collecting Security log
troubleshooting.fix: GPO Advanced Audit Policy → Logon/Logoff → Audit Logon; verify `[WinEventLog://Security]` on DC UF

troubleshooting.cause: Pre-Win2016 field names or XML parsing drift
troubleshooting.fix: Check `XmlWinEventLog:Security` vs `WinEventLog:Security`; align props/transforms for TargetUserName
